backend_parameters.history_direction: forward propagation and current-boundary corrections only
backend_parameters.history_retention_policy: newest N nonconditioning output records plus newest conditioning anchors; older temporal context intentionally removed
backend_parameters.mask_storage: packed NPZ per frame, boundary correction replaces same frame
backend_parameters.maximum_tracks_scope: simultaneously active native objects; IDs never reused
backend_parameters.native_history_radius_scope: native forward lookup radius; explicit record cap overrides retained context
backend_parameters.native_initialization: official init_state on first source JPEG; exact eager-equivalent lazy FP32 image Sequence
backend_parameters.nonconditioning_history_frames_scope: maximum consolidated nonconditioning output records, not a frame-age window

decoded.sampling: source frame indices divisible by frame_stride, starting at zero
